children.value: > Fact From Story Google is accused of siphoning off news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > Fact From Story By 2020, the Knowledge Graph had grown to 500 billion facts about 5 billion entities, much of which was content “misappropriated from Publishers”.

> > > Fact From Story The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Siphoning resources from one entity to another deprives the original entity of those resources.
> > Fact From Story Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot worsen the problem.
> > > Fact From Story Google's SGE offers web searchers a way to seek information in a conversational mode, but ultimately keeps users in Google’s “walled garden” as it “plagiarizes” their content.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Plagiarism is a form of anticompetitive behavior.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Taking content without permission or compensation can harm the content creators.
> Commonsense Knowledge Anticompetitive behavior harms other businesses.
